description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Popeye the Sailor. Features an unbranded spinach-can snack, sailor-cap turn and salute, harmless short-rope knot inspection, a crooked-hat recovery, waiting, a small leap and three articulated sailor running views. Fully closed classic-color clothing and simplified anchor markings are styling adaptations; the pipe is deliberately omitted. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
